en.headline: HKEX chief says investors want more than equities
en.dek: Bonnie Chan told RTHK that Hong Kong should build a broader asset ecosystem, citing stronger turnover and renewed interest in gold futures.
body: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing chief executive Bonnie Chan Yik-ting said on Friday that global investors were looking again at Asia, and at the mainland market in particular, and wanted a wider mix of assets than equities alone.

Speaking on an RTHK programme, Chan said Hong Kong had to build a more diversified asset ecosystem, including fixed income and currencies and commodities, rather than only enlarging the stock market. She linked the task to the national 15th five-year plan's emphasis on consolidating Hong Kong's role as an international financial centre, and said the exchange had a part to play in both primary fundraising and daily secondary-market trading.

Chan said Hong Kong's initial public offerings returned to the top of the global rankings last year, and that listing chapters tailored to artificial intelligence, biotechnology and new-energy companies had been well received. She said average daily stock turnover rose from more than HK$130 billion in 2024 to about HK$250 billion last year, and to more than HK$280 billion so far this year.

She said a recent relaunch of US-dollar gold futures had drawn a strong response, and that yuan-denominated gold futures were under consideration. On the London Metal Exchange, she said Hong Kong already had more than 10 approved warehouses, but that the number was still not enough, and that larger warehouses were being discussed.

zh.headline: 陳翊庭：港股以外也要建多元資產生態圈
zh.dek: 港交所行政總裁在港台節目表示，投資者希望配置股票以外的資產，並提到成交回升及美元黃金期貨反應。
body: 港交所行政總裁陳翊庭周五表示，環球投資者的目光重新回到亞洲，尤其是內地市場，並有意作多元化配置，而非只投資股票。
陳翊庭在香港電台節目《廣播道會客室》說，本港要構建涵蓋固定收益及貨幣、大宗商品的資產生態圈，而不是單純做大股票市場。她指，對接國家十五五規劃、鞏固及提升香港國際金融中心地位，是港交所的重要角色，並要同時顧及一級市場融資及二級市場每日交易。
她說，本港首次公開招股去年重返全球榜首，為人工智能、生物科技及新能源公司而設的上市章節受市場歡迎。股票日均成交由2024年的1300多億元，升至去年約2500億元，今年至今再增至2800多億元。
陳翊庭又說，港交所近期再推出以美元計價的黃金期貨，投資者反應熱烈；以人民幣計價的黃金期貨仍在考慮。她提到，倫敦金屬交易所在港的認可倉庫已有十多個，但數量仍不足，外界亦討論會否物色大型倉庫。
